@src/renderer/components/SettingsDialogLanguagesTab.js please change the grid layout from the fixed 4 columns and replace the sorting logic to use a similar implementation of this example below:



import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';



// Generate 24 sample items

const items = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => ({

  id: i + 1,

  title: `Item ${i + 1}`

}));



// Function to split items into columns

const splitIntoColumns = (items, numColumns) => {

  const itemsPerColumn = Math.ceil(items.length / numColumns);

  const columns = [];

  

  for (let i = 0; i < numColumns; i++) {

    const start = i * itemsPerColumn;

    const end = start + itemsPerColumn;

    columns.push(items.slice(start, end));

  }

  

  return columns;

};



export default function ColumnSortedGrid() {

  const [numColumns, setNumColumns] = useState(2);

  const [columns, setColumns] = useState([]);



  // Update columns when numColumns changes

  useEffect(() => {

    setColumns(splitIntoColumns(items, numColumns));

  }, [numColumns]);



  // Responsive behavior based on window width

  useEffect(() => {

    const handleResize = () => {

      const width = window.innerWidth;

      if (width < 640) {

        setNumColumns(1);

      } else if (width < 768) {

        setNumColumns(2);

      } else if (width < 1024) {

        setNumColumns(3);

      } else {

        setNumColumns(4);

      }

    };



    handleResize();

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);

  }, []);



  return (

    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 p-8">

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">

        <div className="mb-6">

          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">

            Column-Sorted Responsive Grid

          </h1>

          

          {/* Manual column selector */}

          <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">

            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 self-center">

              Columns:

            </span>

            {[1, 2, 3, 4].map(num => (

              <button

                key={num}

                onClick={() => setNumColumns(num)}

                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors ${

                  numColumns === num

                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'

                    : 'bg-white text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50'

                }`}

              >

                {num}

              </button>

            ))}

          </div>

          

          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">

            Current layout: {numColumns} column{numColumns !== 1 ? 's' : ''} 

            (resize window for automatic adjustment)

          </p>

        </div>



        {/* Column-based grid */}

        <div 

          className="grid gap-4"

          style={{

            gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${numColumns}, 1fr)`

          }}

        >

          {columns.map((column, colIndex) => (

            <div key={colIndex} className="flex flex-col gap-4">

              {column.map(item => (

                <div

                  key={item.id}

                  className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6 border border-gray-200 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow"

                >

                  <div className="text-lg font-semibold text-blue-600 mb-2">

                    {item.title}

                  </div>

                  <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">

                    Column {colIndex + 1}

                  </div>

                </div>

              ))}

            </div>

          ))}

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

  );

}

Perfect! I've successfully updated the `SettingsDialogLanguagesTab.js` file with the new simpler column-based layout. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Key Changes Made:

1. **Added `splitIntoColumns` function**: A simpler utility function that splits the languages array into equal columns using `Math.ceil()` for even distribution.

2. **Introduced state management**: 
   - Added `useState` and `useEffect` hooks from React
   - `numColumns` state to track the number of columns (defaults to 4)
   - `columns` state to store the pre-computed column arrays

3. **Responsive behavior**: 
   - Added a resize event listener that automatically adjusts column count based on window width:
     - 1 column for widths < 640px
     - 2 columns for widths < 768px
     - 3 columns for widths < 1024px
     - 4 columns for 1024px and above

4. **Simplified grid layout**:
   - Replaced the complex mathematical distribution logic with a straightforward CSS Grid using `gridTemplateColumns: repeat(${numColumns}, 1fr)`
   - Items now flow naturally down each column before moving to the next

5. **Maintained all functionality**: 
   - Language selection/deselection
   - Custom language deletion
   - Auto-save persistence
   - Alphabetical sorting

The new implementation is much cleaner, more maintainable, and provides better responsive behavior across different screen sizes while maintaining all the original functionality.
